question: Does claiming work before starting reduce duplicated effort when three agents share one repo?
arms: A  — one agent, alone (the cost control)
C3 — three agents, no coordination (the honest comparison)
denominator: wasted lines divided by total lines authored inside the run window, per arm — never divided by agent count, and never compared against arm A
headline: wasted-work % in D versus C3
guardrail: correctness must not fall: every arm's tickets accepted at the same rate, or the headline does not count
stop_rule: all tickets reported done, or 90 minutes wall-clock, whichever comes first
notes: Arm A is here to price the coordination, not to be beaten. See the denominator section of SKILL.md.
